dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I think you’d better spend a little more time getting used
to THIS place before you set off for somewhere else.

<$comeff(3,14)><$voicel(3,5)>So, um, to play <$cdef(27)>jump rope, I spin my vines ’round and
’round.
<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,7)>And then everybody jumps up and down and tries not to
trip on ’em! <$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motionoff(3,804)><$voicel(3,10)>It’s really fun!
<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,7)>If you ever wanna play <$cdef(27)>jump rope</color>, just tell me!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)>I think you should put that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1440)> on your
newly built house.
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>That’ll make it easier for everyone to know where you live!

Designate <$cdef(27)>the house you <$cdef(27)><$spwicon(1)>built as your very own by
placing the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1440)> on top of it!

At the current <$cdef(27)>environment level, you should be able to
buy a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(326)>!
Access the <$cdef(27)>shop and check it out!

As you raise the<$cdef(27)> environment level, you’ll be able to buy
lots and lots of different items from the <$cdef(27)>shop!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Preparations for rebuilding the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center are sure to
be a lot of work.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>There’s no need to rush. You can continue granting
Pokémon’s requests as you have been, <$voicel(1,6)>making them new
homes, <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>and just taking it easy doing whatever you like!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>I’m sure some of the preparations will come together as
you’re doing all that, so you can come back to rebuilding
the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center whenever you’re ready!
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Let’s hear what the <$cdef(27)>professor</color> has to say about celebrating!
